priority_items.summary: Recapture HTML /warnings/ 200 at 01:57:56 prints NEW TROPICAL DISTURBANCE ADVISORY NUMBER A01 ISSUED FROM RSMC NADI Nov 150125 UTC: TD02F centre 1004 hPa near 8.9S 158.5W at 150000 UTC; position poor; slow moving; maximum 10-minute average winds near the centre about 30 kt; Dvorak T2.5/2.5/D0.5/24HRS; potential MODERATE TO HIGH next 24–48 hours; this is the first TDA on TD02F; next TDA around 150800 UTC. Forecasts 12h 9.3S 159.1W / 30 kt; 24h 9.6S 160.2W / 35 kt; outlook 36h 9.9S 161.2W / 45 kt; 48h 10.3S 162.1W / 50 kt. RSS lastBuild NEW 01:25:49 +1200; HTTP LM NEW 13:25:49 GMT. Leftover SWB Number ONE 142321 UTC Gale Warning for Penrhyn, Manihiki and Rakahanga HOLD (9.1S 158.2W / 1004 hPa; RSS item 20023). Recapture ABPW web 200 at 01:57:54 still prints ABPW10 PGTW 141300 COR (web LM HOLD 13:18:12 GMT; tgftp LM HOLD 13:21:05 GMT): INVEST 95P still 9.2S 157.1W, ~853 NM ENE of Pago Pago, 28–33 kt / 1004 mb, potential HIGH. Leftover WTPS21 PGTW 141300 TCFA (tgftp LM HOLD 13:00:33 GMT): numbered warnings not justified; TCFA MSLP 998 mb; reissue by 151300Z. WTPS31 leftover 19 Oct. CAP GU/MP/AS empty (updated 01:52:13Z / recapture 01:55:07Z). EMCI homepage 200 with leftover October NO-WARNING art. Cook Islands News 403. USGS catalog count 16/16. No this-window Oceania M4.5+. NEW Nadi TDA is not a named cyclone and not Category-level. Current ~30 kt 10-min is not the 48h 50 kt outlook. Leftover land Gale Warning is not a named cyclone. JTWC HIGH + TCFA HOLD is not a numbered warning. Not FLASH.
